_comment: Smart Money watchlist. The scanner matches these wallets against each token's
on-chain holders. It ships EMPTY on purpose: no keyless public API curates
proven high-win-rate wallets, and seeding this with invented addresses would
manufacture fake signal. Populate it yourself and the module activates.
Where to source real addresses:
- gmgn.ai        -> Smart Money / top trader leaderboards, copy wallet address
- Nansen         -> Smart Money labels (paid)
- Arkham         -> entity labels and wallet tagging
- Cielo Finance  -> wallet tracker exports
- Solscan/Dune   -> derive your own: wallets with repeated early entries on winners
'address' must be the WALLET (owner) address, not a token account address.
Only 'address' is required; every other field is free-form metadata.
WIN-RATE / TRADES / PROFIT ARE NOT COMPUTED. Deriving them needs every
trade a wallet ever made, priced at execution, across all tokens — that is
the product GMGN/Nansen/Cielo sell. Whatever you put in win_rate, trades
and net_profit_usd is displayed verbatim in notes and Telegram alerts,
labelled as your figure and only as current as you keep it. Set
stats_updated so a stale number is obvious.
Aegis DOES compute, per matched wallet, directly from chain:
amount spent (SOL + USD), entry market cap, and entry timing.
